author: andlo
name: SoundBoard
description: A sound-effects board for OVOS - 'play a drum roll', 'play applause', 'play an air horn'. Same bundled-CC0-sample pattern as ovos-skill-sound-like, but for stock sound effects rather than animal/object sounds. Could plausibly share infrastructure with ovos-skill-sound-like rather than being fully separate - worth revisiting once both exist.
